finding.summary: JSON constructed via printf without escaping. If MODEL (from .env or --model) contains quotes, backslashes, or newlines, the generated run.json will be invalid JSON, breaking downstream tools (baseline.py, compare_baseline.py) that parse it.
finding.fix: Use jq to construct the JSON safely: jq -n --arg commit "$COMMIT" --arg model "$MODEL" --arg date "$(date +%Y-%m-%d)" --argjson k "$K" '{commit: $commit, model: $model, date: $date, k: $k, window: 3}' > "$RUN_DIR/run.json"

label: real_issue
label_reason: Commit 02d37e7 in the PR cites finding R45-fee8a9a-006.
notes: finding.line moved 30 -> 37: at raised_sha fee8a9a the printf that builds run.json is at run_eval.sh:37 (30 is the nvm source line); the review cited the wrong line.
